description: Multi-agent ADVERSARIAL review of the diff BEFORE a pull request is opened (Mode A), and one bounded pass over bot comments (Mode B). Use when about to create or open a PR ("ouvre la PR") or when a bot comments. The Codex hook blocks PR creation until a PASS is recorded for HEAD. Two rounds max.

replace.from: **The hand-launched fan-out drops the Workflow tool, never a phase.**

The global hook `adversarial-pr-guard.mjs` blocks `gh pr create`, `gh pr ready` and MCP pull-request creation tools unless the **current HEAD** (with `--head <branch>`: that branch's tip) is recorded as reviewed.
replace.to: The hook `~/.codex/hooks/adversarial-pr-guard.mjs` blocks `gh pr create`, `gh pr ready` and MCP pull-request creation tools unless the **current HEAD** (with `--head <branch>`: that branch's tip) is recorded as reviewed. It needs codex-cli 0.160.0 or later: on 0.154.0, commands run through code mode (the `exec` tool) skipped PreToolUse hooks. Whatever the version, the review and the sentinel are your own discipline; never read a successful PR creation as proof the review ran.
